step2.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), following the screen display, display the [Diagnosis Menu/TCCS] screen and select [DTC Freeze Data].

atten4.ptxt: If freeze frame data is recorded, [F] is displayed at the left end and the color of that row changes.

step1.ptxt: Check Freeze Frame Data Using TaSCAN

step2.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), following the screen display, select the DTC recording freeze frame data (F displayed) from the [DTC Check] screen.

item.ptxt: The engine condition (ECU data) at the time of DTC detection and before and after detection (before: 1.5 seconds, after: 0.5 seconds) can be checked at 0.5-second intervals.
Check that the malfunction symptoms from the customer problem analysis are consistent with the Diagnostic Trouble Code Chart.
After repair, perform a confirmation test referring to the driving conditions confirmed above.

step2.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), following the screen display, display the [Diagnosis Menu/TCCS] screen and select [DTC].
Select [Clear] on the screen to clear the data.

atten3.ptxt: DTCs and freeze frame data are cleared at the same time.

step1.ptxt: DTC Check (Reading Using Check Engine Warning Light)

step2.ptxt: Using SST (diagnosis check wire No.2), connect between terminals 13 (TC) ←→ 4 (CG) of the DLC3.

atten3.ptxt: Never connect the wrong terminals as this will cause a malfunction.

step2.ptxt: Read the DTC (number of blinks of the check engine warning light).

atten3.ptxt: When letters are used, as in TCCS code C1, the code is expressed as a 2-digit base 16 number. For C1, the light blinks 12 times and then blinks 1 times. (Blinking intervals are the same)

item.ptxt: If normal, the light repeatedly comes on for 0.26 seconds and goes off for 0.26 seconds.
If there is 1 DTC, the same code is output at intervals of 4.5 seconds.
When multiple codes are output, the different codes are output at 2.5-second intervals. After one cycle is complete, the same output is repeated after 4.5 seconds.
If 2 or more code numbers are output, they are displayed in order from the smallest code number.

step1.ptxt: Clearing DTC Memory (Clearing by Removing Fuse)

step2.ptxt: After repairing the malfunctioning area, remove the EFI fuse (20A) and ETC-S fuse (10A) in the engine room for 60 seconds or more, then reconnect them.
Using SST (diagnosis check wire No.2), connect between terminals 13 (TC) ←→ 4 (CG) of the DLC3.

atten3.ptxt: Never connect the wrong terminals as this will cause a malfunction.

step2.ptxt: Check that the normal code is output.

atten3.ptxt: If a malfunction code is output, repair again according to the code.
